inspiration.observed_pattern: Independent category lists are assigned stable ordinal positions and aligned with outer joins so rows from the preserved category remain visible when the other category is shorter.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a regional catalog slot report. CTEs use ROW_NUMBER to assign deterministic slots to two region-specific item lists, then RIGHT JOIN preserves every item in the southern list and exposes NULL northern items for unmatched slots; the schema, data, labels, and reporting purpose are new.

fixture_notes: The northern catalog has two alphabetized items while the southern catalog has three. Slots one and two align by ordinal position; southern slot three remains visible through the RIGHT JOIN with NULL northern columns.
determinism_notes: Region labels, item IDs, item names, ROW_NUMBER ordering, join slots, and final slot ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE regional_catalog (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code CHAR(1) NOT NULL, item_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH northern AS (SELECT item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY item_name, item_id) AS slot FROM regional_catalog WHERE region_code = 'N'), southern AS (SELECT item_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY item_name, item_id) AS slot FROM regional_catalog WHERE region_code = 'S') SELECT n.slot AS north_slot, n.item_name AS north_item, s.slot AS south_slot, s.item_name AS south_item FROM northern AS n RIGHT JOIN southern AS s ON n.slot = s.slot ORDER BY s.slot
